response.overview: A grandmother, naughty and vulgar, feeds her poor great-grandson of one meter and ninety with disgusting baby food. The grandmother is in constant contrast with her granddaughter, whom she reproaches for the habit of nymphomania. On the other hand, the granddaughter reproaches her grandmother for the habit of fishing in the toilet. It will be the granddaughter who throws the powerful "Killer Acid" down the toilet, to prevent her grandmother from fishing. It is the beginning of a bloody series of events...
response.title: Granny Fishes in the Potty
